searchText: Hi, I'm trying to find a technical description of the consensus mechanism of PoS ethereum, I've found https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/consensus-mechanisms/pos/ but it has very little details is there a detailed description of it (in a paper, not a youtube beginner's friendly explanation)? or a link to the consensus algorithm it's based on (i think i've heard the name but forgot it) Thanks in advance 🙏 ok found the casper protocol: https://github.com/cbc-casper/cbc-casper-paper/blob/master/cbc-casper-paper-draft.pdf Question on how are eth2 shards secured ? If the main chain and beacon chain have 3000 validators and say eth2 execution shard has only 300 nodes. To compromise the the eth2 **execution** shards does the attacker have to control 300 nodes or 3000 nodes ? with data only shards each shard benefits from shared security of ETH2. Does this break with execution shards ?
